It's 4:30 PM on a Friday, and you just realized a critical client report—due Monday morning—still needs a major overhaul. Your mood is already low, and the thought of spending your entire weekend on this feels crushing. Your manager just pinged you: 'Hey, any updates on the report?'","options":[{"id":"A","text":"Reply honestly: 'I underestimated the scope. I'll need the weekend to fix it, but I'll have it ready by Monday 9 AM.'","strategy":"Emotionally Regulated"},{"id":"B","text":"Reply: 'Almost done! Just polishing the final touches.' Then silently panic and rush through the weekend.","strategy":"Avoidant"},{"id":"C","text":"Reply: 'I'm behind. Can we push the deadline to Tuesday, or can someone help me with the data section?'","strategy":"Assertive"},{"id":"D","text":"Reply: 'I'll try to get some of it done tonight, but I'm not sure if I can finish.' Then stare at the screen for an hour.","strategy":"Passive"}]},{"id":2,"title":"The Unfair Criticism","difficulty":3,"narrative":"You are a junior graphic designer. During a team meeting, a senior colleague publicly dismisses your latest design concept as 'uninspired' and 'off-brand.' You spent late nights on it, running on only 6 hours of sleep. Your face feels hot, and the room seems to shrink. Everyone is looking at you.","options":[{"id":"A","text":"Take a slow breath and say, 'I appreciate the feedback. Could you specify which elements feel off-brand so I can adjust them?'","strategy":"Emotionally Regulated"},{"id":"B","text":"Stay silent, nod, and immediately open a blank canvas to start over without addressing the comment.","strategy":"Avoidant"},{"id":"C","text":"Say, 'I disagree. I followed the brand guidelines exactly. Let's review them together after the meeting.'","strategy":"Assertive"},{"id":"D","text":"Mumble 'Sure, whatever,' and mentally check out for the rest of the meeting.","strategy":"Passive"}]},{"id":3,"title":"The Social Withdrawal Trap","difficulty":2,"narrative":"You are at a small casual gathering with acquaintances. You've been feeling low for days, and your social battery is at 10%. Someone invites you to join a group board game. You desperately want to go home, but you also fear isolating yourself will make your mood worse.","options":[{"id":"A","text":"Say, 'I'm a bit tired, but I'd love to play one round.' Set a mental timer for 30 minutes, then politely leave.","strategy":"Emotionally Regulated"},{"id":"B","text":"Agree enthusiastically, force a smile, and stay for three hours until you're completely drained.","strategy":"People-Pleasing"},{"id":"C","text":"Say, 'No thanks, I'm not in the mood,' grab your coat, and leave immediately.","strategy":"Avoidant"},{"id":"D","text":"Ignore the invitation, stay on your phone in the corner, and feel guilty the whole time.","strategy":"Passive"}]},{"id":4,"title":"The Medication Doubt","difficulty":3,"narrative":"You are sitting in a quiet café, reading an online forum. You stumble upon a thread where people are sharing negative experiences about the exact medication you're currently taking for your mood. Your heart rate spikes. You start questioning if you should stop taking it immediately.","options":[{"id":"A","text":"Close the tab, take a sip of water, and remind yourself that online anecdotes aren't medical advice. Text your doctor tomorrow.","strategy":"Emotionally Regulated"},{"id":"B","text":"Read every single comment, spiral into anxiety, and flush all your pills down the toilet.","strategy":"Impulsive"},{"id":"C","text":"Screenshot the thread and send it to your psychiatrist with a message: 'Is this something I should worry about?'","strategy":"Analytical"},{"id":"D","text":"Close the tab but keep thinking about it, googling 'medication withdrawal' for the next two hours.","strategy":"Rumination"}]},{"id":5,"title":"The Sleep vs. The Scroll","difficulty":2,"narrative":"It's 11:30 PM. You are lying in bed, phone in hand. You've only been averaging 6 hours of sleep. You know you should put the phone down, but the infinite scroll of short videos is numbing your racing thoughts. The blue light glows in the dark room.","options":[{"id":"A","text":"Set a 10-minute timer. Watch two more videos, then plug the phone in across the room and close your eyes.","strategy":"Emotionally Regulated"},{"id":"B","text":"Say 'just five more minutes' and scroll until 2:00 AM, feeling worse about yourself.","strategy":"Avoidant"},{"id":"C","text":"Throw the phone across the room in frustration, then lie awake stressing about the cracked screen.","strategy":"Impulsive"},{"id":"D","text":"Put on a podcast, leave the phone face down, and focus on the voices until you drift off.","strategy":"Analytical"}]},{"id":6,"title":"The Boundary Test","difficulty":4,"narrative":"You are a freelance writer working from home. It's Saturday morning, and you finally have time to work on your personal project. Your phone rings—it's a friend going through a crisis who wants to vent. You love them, but you've neglected your own needs all week.","options":[{"id":"A","text":"Answer immediately and listen for two hours, completely abandoning your own work schedule.","strategy":"People-Pleasing"},{"id":"B","text":"Ignore the call, turn off your phone, and feel a knot of guilt in your stomach all day.","strategy":"Avoidant"},{"id":"C","text":"Answer and say, 'I care about you, but I'm in the middle of something. Can I call you back at 6 PM when I can give you my full attention?'","strategy":"Assertive"},{"id":"D","text":"Answer, listen impatiently, and give rushed, distracted advice just to end the call faster.","strategy":"Passive-Aggressive"}]},{"id":7,"title":"The Mistake Spiral","difficulty":4,"narrative:"You are a data entry specialist. You just realized you made a small error in a spreadsheet that was sent to five internal stakeholders. It's fixable, but it's embarrassing. Your low mood amplifies the mistake into a catastrophic failure in your mind. You feel a cold sweat coming on.","options":[{"id":"A","text":"Draft a quick, professional correction email to the five stakeholders, fix the error, and move on.","strategy":"Analytical"},{"id":"B","text":"Panic, close your laptop, and hide in the bathroom for an hour, hoping nobody noticed.","strategy":"Avoidant"},{"id":"C","text":"Email your boss immediately, over-apologizing and offering to resign to show how sorry you are.","strategy":"Emotional Flooding"},{"id":"D","text":"Fix the email silently, send the correction, and spend the rest of the day mentally flagellating yourself.","strategy":"Rumination"}]},{"id":8,"title":"The Energy Theft","difficulty":3,"narrative":"You are at the grocery store, exhausted after a long day. The line is long, and the person in front of you is loudly complaining to the cashier about a minor issue. Your patience is non-existent, and your mood is sinking lower by the second.","options":[{"id":"A","text":"Roll your eyes, tap your foot aggressively, and sigh loudly so the person knows they're annoying.","strategy":"Aggressive"},{"id":"B","text":"Put in your noise-canceling headphones, focus on the magazine rack, and practice deep breathing.","strategy":"Emotionally Regulated"},{"id":"C","text":"Switch to a different line, even though it looks longer, just to escape the noise.","strategy":"Avoidant"},{"id":"D","text":"Stand there, absorb the negative energy, and carry that heavy mood home with you.","strategy":"Passive"}]},{"id":9,"title":"The Comparison Trap","difficulty":3,"narrative":"You are scrolling social media late at night. A former colleague just posted about their huge promotion and new car. You are currently struggling to pay rent and feeling stuck in your career. A bitter, heavy feeling settles in your chest.","options":[{"id":"A","text":"Close the app, write down three things you achieved this week, no matter how small.","strategy":"Emotionally Regulated"},{"id":"B","text":"Keep scrolling, comparing yourself to every successful post, and sink deeper into despair.","strategy":"Rumination"},{"id":"C","text":"Comment 'So happy for you!' and then mute their posts so you don't have to see them anymore.","strategy":"Assertive"},{"id":"D","text":"Post a vague, passive-aggressive status about 'fake people' and 'superficial success.'","strategy":"Passive-Aggressive"}]},{"id":10,"title":"The Morning Fog","difficulty":2,"narrative":"Your alarm goes off at 7:00 AM. You slept poorly, totaling 5 hours. The room feels cold and dark. Your brain is foggy, and the thought of facing the day fills you with dread. You have a full schedule ahead.","options":[{"id":"A","text":"Hit snooze three times, drag yourself out of bed at the last minute, and rush out the door.","strategy":"Avoidant"},{"id":"B","text":"Throw the covers over your head and call in sick, even though you aren't physically ill.","strategy":"Withdrawal"},{"id":"C","text":"Sit up, drink a glass of water on your nightstand, and stretch for two minutes before standing.","strategy":"Behavioral Activation"},{"id":"D","text":"Lie in bed scrolling your phone for 45 minutes to numb the dread before getting up.","strategy":"Passive"}]}]}
